sql:
SELECT tss.tss_rank AS rank, t.team_name AS team, tss.tss_points AS points
FROM team_season_standings tss
JOIN seasons s ON tss.season_id = s.season_id
JOIN teams t ON t.team_id = tss.team_id
WHERE s.season = '2022-2023'
ORDER BY tss.tss_rank ASC;

out.notes: Join team_season_standings (tss_*) to seasons on season_id, filter seasons.season = '2022-2023'. Grain is one row per team-season. Select tss_rank, tss_team, tss_points; order by tss_rank ASC. tss_points already includes any deductions—do not adjust. Can use tss_team directly for display or join teams on team_id.
